//: record.mjs --mutate (NE-03, plan §6.3). Each rule is flipped in a child process's module loader only (mutate-hooks.mjs; the working tree is never edited), then BOTH the original JS test and the rule's fixture family must fail. A family with no fixtures yet reports PENDING and names the card that records it; once that card records it, the fixture half is enforced with no edit here. `find` must occur exactly once in `file`.

seam-gap.why: An unbridged seam gets 0.5 s of silence (seam-gap.js; the founder's ruling of 2026-09-24, docs/DECISIONS.md; docs/curation/segment-length-rules.md §6b). The mutant is the 2.0 s audiobook section-break beat the ruling replaced.

jsTest.name: the seam silence is the founder's 0.5 s — one number in both specs

never-early.why: An out-point never stops a segment before its boundary: a fine wake re-reads the playhead and only stops once it is reached (deck-policy.js fineWakeAction, which HtmlAudioBackend asks since NE-14j). The mutant stops half a second short, clipping the payoff.

jsTest.name: an early fine wake reschedules instead of stopping short

15/30.why: Every skip surface steps back 15 s and forward 30 s (media-session.js; the founder's numbers). The mutant is WebKit's 10.

jsTest.name: seekforward asks for a positive 30 seconds by default

pause-silence.why: The postcondition of pause() is silence (#689 report 3): an element audible while the machine says paused is paused anyway. The mutant trusts the reducer and leaves it playing.

patch.find:
this._emit("pause.forced — the element was audible while the machine said paused");
        await this.backend.pause();
patch.replace: this._emit("pause.forced — the element was audible while the machine said paused");

jsTest.name: pause() is a postcondition, not a state transition: an audible element is silenced

warm-across.why: The next item is prepared when it has a FILE, whatever the beat (deck-policy.js warmsAcross, NE-45j), so a rendered narration line and the clip after it are both prepared and clip -> line -> clip is two handovers, not two cold loads. The mutant is the rule it replaced: warm only a segment-to-segment seam (the beat's rule, seam-gap.js).

patch.replace: return to.kind !== "tts" && from.kind !== "tts" && from.end_sec != null && to.end_sec != null;

jsTest.name: a rendered line is warmed across its seam, whatever the beat; a spoken one has no file to warm

route-listener.why: A listener's pause is never resumed when a car comes back (founder Q5, docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-09-25; route-resume.js routeResumeDecision). The mutant is main's EngineCore.onRoute guard before NE-38rs, `case .interrupted(_, true)`, which also matches a listener's own pause and resumes it.

jsTest.name: a listener's pause is never resumed, even when the car is then lost and comes back

stale-load.why: A skip's load that a newer skip already replaced is dropped, not run after it (player-core-9; queue-manager.js _loadItem's stale-target check): the reducer's target is the authority on what loads. The mutant drops the check, so two skips from a speaking line load the first skip's target last and land it into the second's loadingItem.

jsTest.name: a skip's load that a newer skip already replaced is dropped, not run after it (player-core-9)
